title: DevBlog: Secure Blog REST API with JWT, Roles and AI Moderation
tagline: Build a secure, production-style blogging backend from requirements to monitoring, with AI as your pair programmer
description: Over nine phases you build DevBlog like a professional team: requirements, design, a test-first implementation of JWT auth with refresh-token rotation, role-based access, posts with optimistic locking, keyset pagination and full-text search, comments with AI moderation and a human in the loop, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker, optional free-tier deployment, observability and a retrospective. Pick Java, Python or TypeScript; the spec, database and tests are shared. Everything runs on your laptop, and the AI features work offline.

prerequisites.title: Git and the command line basics
One of: Java, Python or TypeScript fundamentals
What HTTP methods and status codes are

outcomes: Turn a brief into testable requirements, user stories and a threat list
Design a REST API contract-first (OpenAPI) with a PostgreSQL schema and ADRs
Implement authentication properly: bcrypt, short-lived JWTs, rotating refresh tokens with reuse detection
Enforce roles and ownership, optimistic locking, keyset pagination and full-text search
Add AI comment moderation that only holds comments for a human and falls back offline
Build CI/CD with GitHub Actions: matrix, caching, reusable workflows, service containers, GHCR
Add request IDs, JSON logs, metrics and a circuit breaker after a game day and a blameless post-mortem
Use AI assistants deliberately and verify every output
ai_feature: AI comment moderation (hold for a human) and post TL;DR summaries: offline rules/template by default, optional Ollama or a free Gemini/Groq key
portfolio_blurb: Built DevBlog, a secure blog REST API: bcrypt + short-lived JWTs with rotating refresh tokens and reuse detection, role- and ownership-based access, optimistic locking, keyset pagination, PostgreSQL full-text search, AI comment moderation with an offline fallback and a human review queue, >=85 % test coverage, GitHub Actions CI/CD to GHCR, Docker, JSON logs, metrics and a circuit breaker added after a game day.
